message.content: {"class":"PRODUCT_DEFECT","reasoning":"The API contract requires summing line-item amounts at full precision and rounding HALF_UP exactly once, so 50.005 + 49.995 must produce 100.00. The service logs show individual amounts being rounded before summation, producing 99.99 in direct violation of the contract; the intervening Money.of() rounding refactor further supports an application regression."}
